scenario: `{p.body.x:d}` on a Float leaf: `d` takes an Int alone (LGRA.2.9.6.5), so the spec is a TypeError at run time (LGRA.2.9.6.11) and `handler` logs. PATH PINNED: the type-against-kind refusal in the interpolation renderer's integer-type arm (libds `render_value`, Mercury `ds.format.value_body`'s `ft_d`). It pins that the refusal is a TypeError on a Json leaf and not a rendering of the Float.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    P p
->
    log info "v {p.body.x:d}"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log info "type error"
